_doc: Emission factors per unit of final energy. Configurable; values are consistent with Swiss LCA methodology (Mobitool / KBOB).

electricity._doc: Per kWh of electricity consumed (Swiss consumer mix, lifecycle including upstream).

diesel_heating._doc: Versioned well-to-wheel factors for the auxiliary fuel-fired heater. Direct exhaust measurements and upstream fuel-chain inventories are kept separate; this is not a complete vehicle LCA.

fuel_profile.description: Mobitool 3.1 average Swiss diesel blend: 94.1% fossil diesel and 5.9% used-cooking-oil biodiesel by volume.

heater_measurements.name: Humphries et al., Diesel Fuel-Fired Heater Emissions from a Battery Electric Transit Bus in Real-World Conditions

assumptions: VECTO fuel energy is converted once from kWh to liters; heater efficiency has already been applied when VECTO determines fuel demand.
Biogenic CO2 has a zero GWP100a characterization factor in the adopted Mobitool method.
Measured total particulate matter is used as an explicit proxy for PM10.
limitations: Direct NOx and particulate measurements come from one heater and are not measurements of the simulated fleet.
Direct N2O was not available in the heater study and CH4 is excluded from this direct GWP model; GWP100a is therefore an estimate rather than a complete measured greenhouse-gas inventory.
No heater-specific start, temperature, duty-cycle or ageing correction is applied.
The PM10 observed range contains two valid stationary tests and is not a confidence interval.

gwp100a.direct_convention: Fossil CO2 only; biogenic CO2 has characterization factor zero in Mobitool.

nox.direct_convention: NO mass converted to NO2-equivalent with 46.0055/30.0061 molecular-mass ratio, then added to measured NO2 mass; pooled over 5.42 L.
nox.upstream_convention: Mobitool/UVEK/ecoinvent elementary flow Nitrogen oxides (NOx as NO2).

pm10.uncertainty_note: Observed range from two valid stationary TPM tests; not a confidence interval. Central value is pooled mass divided by pooled fuel volume.

primaryEnergy.note: Total primary energy already includes the fuel resource energy content; LHV is not added again.

diesel_bus._doc: Per liter of diesel consumed by a full diesel bus engine (lifecycle including upstream). Higher NOx and PM than a heater due to engine combustion characteristics.

diesel_comparator_lca_vehicles._doc: Canonical diesel comparator LCA vehicles per ELETTRA size class. Used for lifecycle phase-share allocation in the yearly-analysis emissions endpoint.
